(āḥ)༄༅/ /in+d+ra mkha' spyod kyi brgyud 'debs bzhugs so/ /༈/swa sti/dpal mchog dang po'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang*/ /dpal mo mkha' spyod zhing

tei:div.tei:p: (āḥ)༄༅// in+d+ra mkha' spyod kyi brgyud 'debs bzhugs so// ༈ /swa sti/ dpal mchog dang po'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang*// dpal mo mkha' spyod zhing gtso rnal 'byor ma// dpal ldan grub pa'i dbang phyug lwa ba par// gsol ba 'debs so mkha' spyod dngos grub stsol// rgyal rigs grub brnyes in+d+ra bhu ti'i zhabs// rgyal yum gtso bo lak+ṣ+mīṃ ka ra dang*// bram ze'i rigs 'khrungs grub chen bir+wa pa// gsol ba 'debs so mkha' spyod dngos grub stsol// brtul zhugs grub pa dpal ldan sha ba ri// de sras thu bo rje btsun mai tri pa// paṇa grub rgya gar phyag na rdo rje la// gsol ba 'debs so mkha' spyod dngos grub stsol// bal po'i paṇa chen bha ren+t+ra ru rtsi// mkhas grub dam pa dzñā na badz+ra zhabs// bstan pa'i mnga' bdag bla chen brtse ba che// gsol ba 'debs so mkha' spyod dngos grub stsol// 'ja' lus mkha' spyod brnyes pa bsod nams brtse// rdo rje 'dzin pa grags pa rgyal mtshan zhabs// 'jam dbyangs bla ma sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta// gsol ba 'debs so mkha' spyod dngos grub stsol// khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rje// de sras thu bo zhang ston dkon mchog dpal// rtse gcig sgrub pa mthar phyin brag phug pa// gsol ba 'debs so mkha' spyod dngos grub stsol// srid gsum 'gran bral bsod nams rgyal mtshan dang*// theg chen chos rje kun dga' bkra shis pa// kwan ting gu shrī nam mkha' bzang po la// gsol ba 'debs so mkha' spyod dngos grub stsol// mkhas mchog ngag dbang grags pa nyi lde ba// mthu stobs dbang phyug rgya gar shes rab mtshan// bdag chen chos rje blo gros rgyal mtshan la// gsol ba 'debs so mkha' spyod dngos grub stsol// mkhas grub dbang po rje btsun rdo rings pa// snyan brgyud bstan pa'i bdag po tshar pa rje// thugs sras snyan brgyud 'dzin pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang*// gsol ba 'debs so mkha' spyod dngos grub stsol// khyab bdag bla ma dbang phyug rab brtan dang*// kun mkhyen mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan dpal// rab 'byams chos rje rin chen rgya mtsho la// gsol ba 'debs so mkha' spyod dngos grub stsol// lung gi dbang phyug phyogs las rnam rgyal ba// zab don snyan brgyud kun gyi mdzod 'dzin pa// drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa la// gsol ba 'debs so mkha' spyod dngos grub stsol// dbang gis rgyud smin sin+dhur dkyil 'khor du// byin rlabs zab mo'i rim pa legs nos shing*// zab mo'i rgyun gyi rnal 'byor bsgom pa'i mthus// tshe 'dir mkha' spyod myur du 'grub par shog

/ces in+d+ra mkha' spyod kyi brgyud pa rin po che la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di yang*/ sde pa glo mkhar nas kyi bzhed pa skong phyir/ mkhyen rab bla ma'i bran gyur bya bral bas 'chi med klung sdings su bris pa'o// maṅga laṃ/ shu bham// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
